en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Aslam, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub, from the one who narrated it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The woman experiencing post-childbirth bleeding would perform Tawaaf by the House (Kabah), and she would Pray, and she would not enter the Kabah’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-ffusayn from Muhammad ibn Aslam from Yunus from Ya’qub from those who narrated to him who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
A woman who experiences Istihadah (a form of menses) can perform Tawaf around the House and Salat (prayer), but she cannot enter the House.’”
